hook: Attention Is All You Need: No Recurrence Required

bullets.text: Attention models dependencies regardless of distance in input or output sequences.
The Transformer relies entirely on attention, eschewing recurrence to draw global dependencies.
Future plans include extending the model to images, audio, and video modalities.
Recurrent models preclude parallelization within training examples, limiting batching at longer sequence lengths due to memory constraints.
ConvS2S and ByteNet struggle to learn dependencies between distant positions because operation counts grow with distance.
Single convolutional layers fail to connect all input-output pairs, requiring O(n/k) or O(logk(n)) layer stacks.
The Transformer uses stacked self-attention and point-wise fully connected layers for both encoder and decoder.
It employs h=8 parallel attention heads, each with dimension dk=dv=64, to attend to different subspaces simultaneously.
Self-attention connects all positions with constant sequential operations, unlike recurrent layers requiring O(n) operations.
The big Transformer model achieves a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4 on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation.
On WMT 2014 English-to-French, the model reaches a BLEU score of 41.0 at less than one-quarter the training cost.
The model generalizes to English constituency parsing with an F1 score of 92.7, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art of 92.1.
